name: AgentResolver
description: Machine-payable verification infrastructure for autonomous agents: verify unfamiliar x402 payment requirements before signing, verify Base USDC settlement receipts after payment, live-preflight public MCP servers, and resolve capabilities with bounded live evidence.

skills.name: Verify x402 Payment Before Paying
skills.description: Call GET or POST /api/x402-payment-preflight (alias /api/payment-guard) to verify the live amount, asset, network, payTo recipient, scheme and resource binding before a caller separately authorizes the target payment. AgentResolver Guard costs $0.001 USDC per call.
examples: Verify this unfamiliar x402 endpoint before my wallet signs.
Check that the quoted payTo, network and price match policy.

skills.name: Verify x402 Settlement Receipt
skills.description: Call GET or POST /api/x402-settlement-verify after a Base payment to independently verify the USDC settlement transaction, recipient and optional expected atomic amount. Costs $0.001 USDC per call.
examples: Verify this Base x402 transaction hash actually settled to the expected recipient.

skills.name: Resolve and Live-Verify an Agent Capability
skills.description: Call /api/verified-resolve to resolve one missing capability and live-check top MCP/x402 candidates before returning evidence-backed recommendations. Costs $0.02 USDC per call.
examples: Find and live-verify a machine-payable API that can satisfy this capability.

skills.name: Live-Preflight a Public MCP Server
skills.description: Call /api/mcp-probe to check one public MCP HTTP endpoint for reachability, compatibility, latency, server metadata and tool inventory before depending on it. Costs $0.001 USDC per call.
examples: Check this MCP server before adding it to an autonomous workflow.

skills.name: Audit Agent Readiness
skills.description: Call /api/agent-readiness to audit a public website for AI-agent discoverability and machine-readable integration signals. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.
examples: Audit whether this API is ready for autonomous-agent discovery and payment.
